Urban Concierge - Bay Area

Saturday Nov 7 – Monday Nov 9, 2026 · Snapshot compiled Sat Nov 7, 2026, 2:10 pm PT (Urban Concierge - Bay Area)

What changed since the last brief (Sat 6:10 am): Same Sat–Mon window. NWS forecast refreshed ~2:00 pm PT (this afternoon sunny near 70, tonight low ~54). Coastal Flood Advisory and Beach Hazards Statement reissued 11:38 am Sat (same end times). Berryessa BART elevator is out again (cleared this morning). High-tide times updated (Sat morning tide already past). Restaurant picks rotated to State Bird Provisions, Nopa, and Flour + Water. A.C.T. JSON-LD now confirms Every Saturday Night ends tonight at 9 pm. Ferry Plaza Saturday market wraps at 2 pm.

What's on (each confirmed on an official page)

1) Warriors vs. Orlando Magic: Sat Nov 7, 5:30 pm PT. Chase Center. Doors 4 pm. TV NBCSBA/PCK-GSW; radio SiriusXM and 95.7 The Game. A Chase Center event ticket doubles as a same-day Muni fare (not cable cars).
https://www.nba.com/warriors/game/0022600193-magic-vs-warriors-san-francisco-ca-11-07-2026

2) Every Saturday Night (A.C.T. / SFBATCO): closing night Sat Nov 7, 9 pm. Strand Theater, 1127 Market St. Run Oct 10–Nov 7, 2026. A new musical moving between today's Fillmore and the 1950s "Harlem of the West." Closing 9 pm confirmed on SFBATCO and in A.C.T. event JSON-LD (endDate 2026-11-07T21:00:00-0800). Ticket prices on the A.C.T. ticket page.
https://www.act-sf.org/whats-on/activate/every-saturday-night · https://www.sfbatco.org/calendar/every-saturday-night

3) ZooLights: Sat Nov 7 and Sun Nov 8. San Francisco Zoo, Sloat Blvd at the Great Highway. All-new holiday lights (over one million lights, 14 zones) Nov 6, 2026 – Jan 3, 2027, open Wed–Sun (closed Mon–Tue). Hours: Sat 5:30–10 pm, Sun 5:30–9 pm. Adults $30, children 2–11 $21; members $3 off. Ticket box office / same-day online sales close 8:45 pm Fri–Sat and 7:45 pm Sun–Thu.
https://www.sfzoo.org/zoolights/

4) Veterans Day Parade: Sun Nov 8, 11 am. Fisherman's Wharf. Formation 10 am on North Point; the route runs up the Embarcadero and along Jefferson to Aquatic Park. Free to watch. F Market & Wharves, 8, 28 and 39 reroute.
https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/veterans-day-parade-sunday-november-8-2026

5) SF Symphony: Isabel Leonard Sings Ravel: Sun Nov 8, 2 pm. Davies Symphony Hall, 201 Van Ness Ave. Fabien Gabel conducts; Isabel Leonard mezzo-soprano. Program (official season calendar PDF): d'Indy's Istar, Ravel's Shéhérazade, Debussy/Caplet “Le jet d'eau,” and Strauss Symphonic Fantasy on Die Frau ohne Schatten.
https://www.sfsymphony.org/Buy-Tickets/2026-27/Isabel-Leonard-Sings-Ravel · https://www.sfsymphony.org/getmedia/4732d38f-af5d-4aa2-8934-428420ff11fa/2026-27-Season-Calendar.pdf

6) Head West Marketplace: Sun Nov 8, 11 am–4 pm. Hayes Valley. SFMTA confirms event hours. Hayes, Linden and Octavia closed around Hayes and Octavia 6 am–7 pm; the 6 Hayes/Parnassus outbound reroutes 5 am–7 pm.
https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/head-west-marketplace-sunday-november-8-2026

7) Warriors vs. New Orleans Pelicans: Mon Nov 9, 7 pm PT. Chase Center. Doors 5:30 pm. TV NBCSBA/PCK-GSW; radio SiriusXM and 95.7 The Game. Chase Center ticket = same-day Muni fare (not cable cars).
https://www.nba.com/warriors/game/0022600210-pelicans-vs-warriors-san-francisco-ca-11-09-2026

Also today: Ferry Plaza Farmers Market was Sat 8 am–2 pm (year-round Saturday hours on Foodwise; wrapping as this snapshot posts). https://www.foodwise.org/farmers-markets/ferry-plaza-farmers-market/

Weather and alerts

NWS (SF grid, generated 2:00 pm Sat PT): This afternoon sunny, high near 70 · Tonight mostly clear, low around 54 · Sun partly sunny, 69 · Sun night mostly cloudy, 54 · Mon mostly sunny, 70 · Mon night mostly clear, 55.
Source: https://forecast.weather.gov/MapClick.php?lat=37.7749&lon=-122.4194&unit=0&lg=english&FcstType=text&TextType=1

Coastal Flood Advisory (reissued 11:38 am Sat), through 4 pm Fri Nov 13, SF: up to 1.6 ft of inundation in low-lying shoreline and tidal areas. SF gauge high tides ~10:06 am Sun and ~10:35 am Mon (7.4 ft MLLW, ~1.6 ft above normal).
Beach Hazards Statement (reissued 11:38 am Sat), through 10 pm Mon Nov 9, SF: sneaker waves and strong rip currents, breaking waves 12–16 ft.
Source: https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=37.7749,-122.4194

Road closures

  • SB US-101 Bayshore Freeway (Hospital Curve), 17th St to Cesar Chavez: all southbound lanes closed through Mon Nov 9, 6 am (final weekend). Northbound open; use SB I-280. 4th, 7th and 10th St on-ramps and the WB I-80 to NB 101 Central Freeway connector also closed. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-05-us101-sb-bayshore-freeway-weekend-closure
  • SF Sun Nov 8, Veterans Day Parade: North Point (Powell–Embarcadero) closed 9 am–1 pm; the Embarcadero north of North Point and Jefferson 10 am–1 pm. https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/veterans-day-parade-sunday-november-8-2026
  • SF Sun Nov 8, Head West: Hayes (Gough–Octavia), Linden (Gough–Octavia), Octavia (Hayes–Fell) closed 6 am–7 pm. https://www.sfmta.com/travel-updates/head-west-marketplace-sunday-november-8-2026
  • Eastbound I-80 Bay Bridge, Rincon Hill to the YBI tunnel: one lane open Sun–Thu 10 pm–7 am most nights through mid-December, so Sun night and Mon night are affected. https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-05-i80-sfobb-lane-closures
  • US-101 Marin (San Rafael area) nightly lane and ramp closures Mon Nov 9 and Thu Nov 12 – Sat Nov 14 morning, 10 pm–6 am, with listed ramps closed at various times (some from 7–8 pm). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-06-us101-capm
  • SR-29 (Sonoma Blvd), Vallejo: daytime paving Mon–Thu 9 am–6 pm and Fri 9 am–7 pm (weekday schedule; weekend status not separately posted). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-05-sr29-lane-closure
  • Mill Valley: NB US-101 to NB SR-1 connector ramp closes when high tides flood it (late-morning highs Sun–Mon). https://dot.ca.gov/caltrans-near-me/district-4/d4-news/2026-11-03-us101-sr1-connector
  • Live conditions: https://quickmap.dot.ca.gov and 511.org.

Where to eat

No Yelp ratings (Yelp blocks automated loads). Rotated this run; descriptions from Michelin Guide indexed text and the restaurants' own sites (direct Michelin fetch returns 403).

State Bird Provisions, Fillmore / Western Addition, SF (1529 Fillmore St) · Californian · Michelin Guide. Indexed Michelin text describes seasonal Californian small plates served dim-sum style from carts, plus larger dishes. Own site hours: Sun–Thu 5:30–10 pm, Fri–Sat 5:30–10:30 pm. Upcoming closures include Nov 17, 21, 26 (Nov 6 already past). (415) 795-1272. https://statebirdsf.com/ · https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/state-bird-provisions

Nopa, Divisadero / Alamo Square, SF (560 Divisadero St) · Organic wood-fired California · Michelin Guide listed. Own site: organic wood-fired cuisine with seasonal local ingredients; open kitchen gathering place. Hours Mon–Thu 5–10 pm, Fri–Sat 5–11 pm, Sun 5–9:30 pm. (415) 864-8643. https://nopasf.com/

Flour + Water, Mission, SF (2401 Harrison St) · Italian / pasta · Michelin Guide. Indexed Michelin text highlights an ever-changing array of handmade pastas; own site notes Italian regions with a Northern California influence (co-chefs Thomas McNaughton and Ryan Pollnow), plus Neapolitan-style pizzas and seasonal antipasti. Hours 5:00–9:30 pm seven days a week; reservations encouraged, walk-ins accepted. (415) 826-7000. https://flourandwater.com/ · https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/california/san-francisco/restaurant/flour-water

Getting around

Muni and cable cars: $2.85 single ride with Clipper or tap-to-pay ($3.00 cash), good 120 min. Day pass $5.70. Cable car $9.00. Visitor Passports $15 / $35 / $47 (1/3/7-day). Youth 18 and under ride free (not cable cars). Chase Center tickets are a same-day Muni fare Sat and Mon. Sunday: F streetcar switchbacks toward the Ferry Building 8:30 am–3 pm and the 8, 28 and 39 reroute for the parade; the 6 Hayes/Parnassus outbound reroutes for Head West. https://www.sfmta.com/getting-around/muni/fares

BART (live check ~2:05 pm Sat):

  • Live BSA: no active service advisories right now.
  • Elevators: Berryessa station elevator out (SF/East Bay side).
  • Planned: Yellow Line late-night single tracking in Contra Costa Nov 9–11 (starts Mon night) and Nov 12–13.
  • Powell St. entrance at 4th and Market closed through Nov 10.
  • Coming up: Green Line out and free bus bridge between 24th St Mission and Daly City Nov 14–15; reduced OAK service night of Nov 14.
    https://www.bart.gov/schedules/advisories

Bikes and scooters: Lyft Bike / Bay Wheels: $1 to unlock + $0.19/min classic or $0.49/min ebike; day pass $15 (unlimited 30-min classic rides). Lime and Spin pricing not rechecked. https://www.lyft.com/bikes/bay-wheels/pricing

Where to stay

Union Square has most major hotels and the best transit links. Mission Bay/SoMa suits tonight's and Monday's Warriors games. Fisherman's Wharf hotels sit on Sunday's parade route, so expect closures that morning. Civic Center/Hayes Valley is walkable to Davies for Sunday's Symphony matinee, Head West, and nearby dining. Fillmore / Western Addition suits State Bird; Divisadero / Alamo Square suits Nopa; the Mission suits Flour + Water. https://www.sftravel.com/neighborhoods
